input.rationale: Array's indemnity in Section 16.2 is limited to Array Territory product activities, Array-sponsored Clinical Studies and breaches of Array's Article 15 representations; it contains no limb for third-party claims that the Products or our exercise of the licensed Array Patents/Know-How infringe or misappropriate third-party IP (and Section 15.4 disclaims any non-infringement warranty), while our Section 16.1(a) indemnity covers all Third Party Claims from our Ono Territory activities. That fails the fallback, which requires at minimum a licensor IP indemnity. We take the fallback position: a single concise IP indemnity limb with the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications), the procure/modify/replace/refund remedy ladder and a 3x annual fees super-cap, which is the least intrusive cure and leaves the existing mutual architecture and Section 16.3 procedure untouched.

ops.text: IP Indemnification. Array shall indemnify each Ono Indemnitee against any Third Party Claim alleging that any Product or Ono's exercise of the licenses granted by Array hereunder infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right of a Third Party, excluding any claim arising from Ono's modifications, Ono's combinations with other products or materials, or Ono's specifications. Array shall, at its option, procure for Ono the right to continue use, modify the infringing item, or replace the infringing item, and if none of the foregoing is available, refund the amounts paid by Ono for the affected Product. Array's total liability under this Section 16.2A shall not exceed 3 times the annual fees paid by Ono under this Agreement.
